# Suites With Keith

> Suites With Keith is the website of Keith Pence, a luxury travel advisor with Fora Travel (Fora X) specializing in Europe, honeymoons and luxury hotels. It publishes Keith's first-hand hotel reviews, head-to-head hotel comparisons, rankings and destination guides, drawn from hotels he has stayed at or toured.

- Booking a hotel through Keith costs the same as booking direct, and usually adds Fora perks such as a space-available upgrade, daily breakfast and a hotel credit. Hotel bookings are complimentary.
- Comparison pages say whether Keith stayed at or toured each hotel, and when.
- To plan a trip, use the inquiry form on any page. More about Keith: https://suiteswithkeith.com/about.html

## About Keith and how booking works

- [About Keith](https://suiteswithkeith.com/about.html): Who plans your trip, what it costs, and how it works. Hotel bookings are complimentary; the judgment comes with them.
- [Corporate Travel](https://suiteswithkeith.com/corporate-travel.html): Executive travel, incentive trips, and team offsites, planned by one advisor with the hotel relationships behind every Suites With Keith trip.
- [Private Boat Transfers in the Greek Islands](https://suiteswithkeith.com/private-boat-transfers.html): Skip the ferry line. I arrange private boat transfers between the Cyclades (Sifnos to Milos, Santorini to Folegandros, Mykonos to Paros) on your schedule, with cars waiting on both ends.
- [Private Jet Charter, Transparent Pricing](https://suiteswithkeith.com/private-jet-charter.html): I arrange private jet charter through vetted operators. There's no fee for a point-to-point flight, my charter partner's quote is passed through as-is, and a flat planning fee applies only when a trip has several stops. What a jet actually costs, and what to know before you book.
- [Services & FAQ](https://suiteswithkeith.com/services.html): What working with a travel advisor costs, and what it covers: complimentary hotel bookings, full-trip planning for trips from $10K, yachts, jets, villas and an annual retainer.
- [Suites With Keith | Better Rooms. Better Trips.](https://suiteswithkeith.com/): Better Rooms. Better Trips. Hotel recommendations from an advisor who tours the rooms before recommending them. Europe, honeymoons, and hotels worth the airfare. Booking is complimentary.
- [What Planning With Me Looks Like](https://suiteswithkeith.com/planning-with-swk.html): One Greece trip, from the first email to the finished itinerary, and everything I send in between. Yours would look nothing like it.

## Rankings and best-of lists

- [10 World's Most Jaw-Dropping Hotel Pools](https://suiteswithkeith.com/top-hotel-pools.html): Ten hotel pools worth planning a trip around, from a cave pool on Santorini to a private island in the French Riviera, chosen by travel advisor Keith Pence.
- [Best Luxury Hotels on Lake Como, Ranked (2026)](https://suiteswithkeith.com/lake-como-hotels-ranked.html): Keith's firsthand ranking of the best luxury hotels on Lake Como after stays and site visits in October 2026: Grand Hotel Tremezzo, Il Sereno, Passalacqua, Villa d'Este, the Lake Como EDITION and Villa Serbelloni, and who each one is right for.
- [Best Santorini Honeymoon Hotels, Ranked](https://suiteswithkeith.com/santorini-hotels-ranked.html): Keith's firsthand ranking of the best Santorini honeymoon hotels, based on site tours and stays: who to book, who to skip, and who to send to each.
- [Jupiter: The Best Villa on Paros, Greece](https://suiteswithkeith.com/best-villa-paros-jupiter.html): Keith's pick for the best villa on Paros: Jupiter, the five-bedroom villa at Parīlio that he toured in person and named Best Paros Villa in his Greece Collection. A private house for families and groups, with a design hotel's service behind it, and boat days and dinners arranged around the house.
- [Keith's Rankings](https://suiteswithkeith.com/rankings.html): Firsthand hotel rankings, city by city and island by island, from real stays and site tours. No press trips, no sponsored placements.
- [The 10 Best Luxury Hotels in Greece & the Greek Islands](https://suiteswithkeith.com/best-hotels-greece.html): After four weeks in Greece and 38 hotel visits across seven islands, here are Keith's 10 favorite luxury hotels, plus smart island pairings and how to move between them.
- [The Fifteen: Honeymoon Hotels I'd Book Anywhere](https://suiteswithkeith.com/the-fifteen.html): A shortlist rather than a ranking. Fifteen honeymoon hotels I'd book anywhere in the world, each visited or booked repeatedly, each right for a different kind of couple.
- [The Greek Island Matrix: 14 Islands, 21 Hotels, Placed Honestly](https://suiteswithkeith.com/greek-island-matrix.html): Fourteen Greek islands mapped from rustic to polished and undiscovered to well-trodden, plus the 21 hotels I'd actually book, island by island.
- [The Italy Matrix: 14 Places, 50 Hotels, Placed Honestly](https://suiteswithkeith.com/italy-matrix.html): Fourteen places in Italy mapped from rustic to polished and undiscovered to well-trodden, plus the 50 hotels I'd actually book, from the Dolomites to the Amalfi Coast.
- [The World's 50 Best Hotels 51–100: My Ten Picks](https://suiteswithkeith.com/worlds-50-best-51-100.html): The full World's 50 Best Hotels 2026 extended list, Nos. 51–100, plus travel advisor Keith Pence's ten picks, every one bookable through him with upgrades, breakfast and hotel credits at no extra cost.
- [The World's Most Beautiful Hotel Tennis Courts](https://suiteswithkeith.com/top-hotel-tennis-courts.html): Eleven hotel tennis courts worth planning a trip around, from a cliffside court in Positano to a private island in the Maldives, chosen by travel advisor Keith Pence.
